sources.title: Odell Beckham Jr. was on the field for three plays on Monday night
sources.description: The first real sighting of Giants receiver Odell Beckham Jr. on Monday night happened when ESPN cameras captured him giving his former head coach, Sean McVay, a post-game hug.
